# Subishi Sierra

> A 36-acre gated community of 336 luxury villas on Maheshwaram Road, Kalwakole, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. TG RERA No. P02400011199.

## Key facts
- Land area: 36 acres
- Total villas: 336
- Plot size: 300 sq. yards
- Built-up area: 3,600 sft per villa, across three floors
- Orientation options: east facing and west facing
- Main avenues: 60 ft wide; 4 park pockets; 1 grand clubhouse
- Location: Kalwakole, Maheshwaram Road — about 15 minutes from ORR Exit 15
- Under 10 minutes: NH44, ORR Exit 15 and 16, Statue of Equality, JIMS Hospital, E City Maheshwaram
- About 20 minutes: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, DPS Aerocity, Amity University, LV Prasad Eye Institute

## Amenities
Clubhouse with auditorium and guest rooms, swimming pool and deck, fitness centre, yoga studio, walking track, parks, pickleball, tennis, badminton, basketball, volleyball, cricket, indoor games, children's play area.

## Specifications summary
RCC framed structure with red brickwork; vitrified porcelain flooring; aluminium windows (Tostem or equivalent); sanitaryware by Duravit / American Standard; CP fittings by Grohe or equivalent; 3-phase supply with 3KVA DG backup per home; STP for water recycling.

## Enquiries
Master layout and plot availability are shared on request through the Enquiry Now form on the site.
